description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of time spent on different stages of a question-answering process, categorized by percentile. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "Avg.", "50%", "75%", and "90%", indicating average and percentile values. The vertical axis is labeled "sec." and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 8.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.0. Each category is represented by a stacked bar, comprising four segments colored in different shades of blue, corresponding to "Search", "Extract", and "Retrieval" as indicated by the legend, although "Extract" is not visible in the chart. The bars are not sorted in a specific order other than being arranged by percentile. The "Search" segment is the largest component in each bar, with values ranging from approximately 1.7 seconds at the "50%" category to around 2.0 seconds at the "90%" category. The total height of the bars increases as the percentile increases, with the "Avg." bar at around 4.8 seconds, "50%" at approximately 3.3 seconds, "75%" at about 5.0 seconds, and "90%" at roughly 8.5 seconds. The bars are not visually emphasized or annotated beyond the labeling and coloring.
